bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided public programming question records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, used Python re and dictionary rules to extract organization and date spans from public programming questions, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
